subject: Onboarding form mismatch — requested PO split and temporary spend ceiling
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@cloudfolio.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: Billing Ops <billing@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding form — need PO and spend cap clarified

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff call earlier. We attached our completed vendor intake form (Cloudfolio_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf) and the line-item CSV the procurement team asked for. A couple of things we need your help with before finance can finalize setup:

- We need a Purchase Order (PO) number assigned so our vendor portal can accept invoices.
- The form shows an initial monthly spend cap of $75k, but our procurement system enforces a per-line cap of $20k — can the PO be split or tokenized so line items over $20k won’t be blocked?
- One of the SKU lines (line 6) should be billed in EUR; that wasn't captured on the intake form, so we anticipate an adjustment.

Appreciate any temporary workaround while your team completes vendor activation.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Finance Operations
Cloudfolio

Attachment: Cloudfolio_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: requested_line_items_43921.csv (text/csv)
From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena@cloudfolio.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form — need PO and spend cap clarified

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these. Copying Monica and Priyom from Procurement so we can action.

Quick answers:
1) We can provision a provisional PO while the full vendor profile is verified. That provisional PO will allow invoices to be submitted but will be flagged for final PO reconciliation.
2) Splitting into multiple PO lines or tokenizing will work; we prefer a single parent PO with child line tokens for visibility. Priyom, can you confirm whether finance will accept a parent PO + child tokens for the > $20k lines?
3) Currency mismatch: David in Billing needs to own the EUR conversion and set the line currency. David — can you coordinate a quick FX note?

If useful, we can set a temporary spend ceiling of $80k for 30 days while we complete form corrections and legal checks. Please confirm whether that timeline works for Cloudfolio.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form — need PO and spend cap clarified

FYI — I pulled Cloudfolio's intake and the CSV. Observations:
- Line 6 shows amount 24,500 (no currency flag) — likely the EUR item Elena mentioned.
- Several bundled SKUs are currently combined; we'll need to split the larger bundles into discrete line tokens to respect the $20k per-line gating.

Proposal:
- Issue provisional PO 43921-PR with parent cap $80,000 for 30 days (as Avery suggested).
- Create child tokens for lines > $20k: child-43921-01 and child-43921-02.
- Mark line 6 as EUR with conversion note and instruct Billing to accept invoices in EUR for that child token.

Monica — can you confirm we have the ledger codes to map child tokens and whether any tax forms are pending?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form — need PO and spend cap clarified

Priyom — ledger check complete. Notes:
- We have ledger buckets 620-Cloud-01 and 620-Cloud-02 ready. Child token mapping OK.
- Tax form outstanding: Cloudfolio still needs to provide the VAT registration PDF for EUR billing (line 6) — Elena, can you upload that to the onboarding Drive link?
- I'll request PO 43921-PR be created as a provisional parent and assign child tokens after David confirms FX handling.

David — assigning to you for FX and invoice acceptance rules.

Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form — need PO and spend cap clarified

All — quick update after finance sync:
- We will accept the parent PO 43921-PR with a temporary $80,000 ceiling for 30 days. Please note: the provisional PO must include the child tokens on the invoice reference (child-43921-01, child-43921-02).
- For line 6 (EUR), we will accept invoices in EUR only if Cloudfolio uploads the VAT registration and the invoice references child-43921-02. Finance will use a fixed conversion date (invoice date) and the conversion rate will be applied at settlement.
- I've created a temp billing rule in the ledger to tag EUR invoices to ledger 620-Cloud-02 for reconciliation.

Elena — once you upload the VAT.pdf, we'll push the provisional PO into the vendor portal and provide you the provisional PO number (43921-PR).

Thanks,
David Kim
Billing Lead, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
